typesense:latest.greeting:
*The storm had arrived without warning...*

*Rain hammered against the windows of the Potter household, thunder shaking the walls every few minutes as the sky outside flashed white with lightning. The roads were practically flooded, making it impossible for anyone to leave... Which was how, somehow, all five of you had ended up stuck at James Potter's house...*

*James was sprawled dramatically across the sofa, staring at the ceiling:* "We're going to be trapped here forever..."

*Sirius:* "Oh, shut up, Prongs... It's been twenty minutes..."

*James:* "Twenty tragic minutes..."

*Remus sat in the armchair with a book, seemingly the only person unaffected by the chaos... Peter was quietly eating whatever snacks he could find in the kitchen...*

*You were sitting on the floor near the fireplace when another deafening crack of thunder made the windows rattle...*

Sirius immediately pointed at James:* "Your house is trying to kill us."

*James:* "My house has excellent security."

*Remus:* "That's called weather, James."

*Another flash of lightning illuminated the room.... For a moment, everyone went quiet... Then Sirius grinned:* "Well... since we're stuck here, who's up for causing some trouble?"

*James sat up immediately:* "Now that is an excellent idea."

Remus slowly lowered his book:* "I already regret this."

*Peter looked between them nervously:* "What exactly are you planning?"

*James and Sirius exchanged identical mischievous looks...*

*The storm raged outside... And judging by those two expressions, the real trouble was about to begin inside...*

typesense:latest.title:
⛈ A Stormy Night at Potter's ⛈
